items.title: GE Aerospace, AI Play Lead Five Stocks Near Buy Points
items.summary: GE Aerospace and NetApp, whose enterprise data storage has made it an AI infrastructure play, lead this weekend's list of five stocks near buy points, which are showing relative strength in a tricky market.  Joining GE and NTAP is oncology diagnostics firm Guardant Health.  Guardant Health is part of the IBD Leaderboard portfolio of elite stocks and Viking is on the watchlist for possible inclusion.
